requirements.businessContext: The Auction Economy module governs all money & scoring math for auction-format leagues: weekly GW payouts based on rank, the FMV ladder used to price trades and squad value, switch taxes for mini-auctions, and the per-team GW scoring breakdown (raw FPL points + owned-club synergy ×1.5 + tier-based club-result bonus). It also exposes per-team finance/ledger views, league-wide scoring status, and a superadmin override for manual score adjustments. Out of scope: bidding/squad mechanics (module 10), trade execution (module 12), slot/club-auction lifecycle (module 13).

userStories.iWant: to view my full economic breakdown — initial budget, current purse, total spent, total income, refunds, and GW-by-GW income history
userStories.soThat: I can see where my money has gone and plan future bids

userStories.iWant: to see a chronological ledger of every transaction (initial budget, purchases, releases, GW payouts, trades, transfer fees, slot unlocks, penalty redemptions, club purchases) with a running balance
userStories.soThat: I can audit my purse history and reconcile against the displayed current purse

userStories.iWant: to see a summary of every team's finance state (purse, spent, income, refunds, forfeited, released/pending/active counts, net P&L) in one call
userStories.soThat: I can audit the league economy at a glance

userStories.iWant: to view a single GW's per-team scoring (rank, GW points, payout, per-player breakdown with raw points + synergy + club result) and switch between processed GWs and the in-flight live GW
userStories.soThat: I can follow the league's weekly results without logging in

userStories.iWant: to see how many teams have been scored for each GW (scored vs total managers)
userStories.soThat: I know which GWs still need processing

userStories.iWant: to compute each team's GW score as raw FPL points + ×1.5 synergy on owned-club players + tier-based club-result bonus, then rank teams and assign rank-based payouts
userStories.soThat: auction leagues have a money-driven competitive structure each GW

userStories.iWant: to atomically write each GW's scores, update team purses and totalIncome, and finalize pending releases on cycle boundaries (GW 10/20/30) with 50% refunds
userStories.soThat: scoring + payouts + release refunds stay consistent and can't half-commit

userStories.iWant: to use a reverse-tiered FMV ladder (£20K/pt for 0–100, £40K/pt for 100–200, £60K/pt for 200+) plus an 80% floor for trade pricing
userStories.soThat: early-season punts stay cheap and tradeable while elite scorers appreciate aggressively late in the season

userStories.iWant: to compute switch taxes that penalize top-third teams more (50pt + 15% agent fee) and bottom-third teams less (30pt + 5%) based on season rank
userStories.soThat: mini-auction switches act as a rubber-band balancer between leaders and laggards

userStories.iWant: to manually override the synergyBonus and clubResultBonus on a scored row with a mandatory audit reason
userStories.soThat: I can correct scoring errors without re-running the whole GW

userStories.iWant: to preserve the historical PL team and synergy snapshot per player when reprocessing a GW
userStories.soThat: mid-season PL transfers don't retroactively re-route synergy on already-scored gameweeks

userStories.iWant: GW payout notifications when my GW score is finalized and refund notifications when pending releases are credited
userStories.soThat: I know the moment money lands in my purse

businessRules.rule: GW payouts are fixed by rank: 1=£2.5M, 2=£2.1M, 3=£1.8M, 4=£1.6M, 5=£1.4M, 6=£1.2M, 7=£1.1M, 8=£1.0M, 9=£0.9M, 10=£0.8M; rank 11+ receives a £0.5M minimum floor.
Refund on release equals 50% of the purchase price, rounded down (`Math.floor(purchasePrice * 0.5)`); the remaining 50% is forfeited.
Computed purse = initialBudget + totalIncome + totalRefunds − totalSpent.
FMV ladder is reverse-tiered: pts 0–100 contribute £20K/pt, pts 100–200 contribute £40K/pt, pts 200+ contribute £60K/pt; FMV = purchasePrice + tiered appreciation.
FMV floor used for trade pricing = `Math.floor(FMV × 0.8)` (80% of FMV).
Negative totalPoints (sanity) are clamped to 0 inside `calculateFMV` via `Math.max(0, totalPoints)` before tier math.
Switch tax is bucketed by season rank: top third (rank ≤ ceil(N/3)) = 50pt tax + 15% agent fee; middle third (rank ≤ ceil(2N/3)) = 40pt + 10%; bottom third = 30pt + 5%.
Agent fee cash component for a switch = `Math.floor(purchasePrice × agentFeePercent/100)`; totalCashCost = purchasePrice + agentFee.
Team GW total = rawPoints + synergyBonus + clubResultBonus, where rawPoints = sum of owned players' FPL points for the GW.
Synergy bonus = 0.5 × raw points for any owned player whose PL team equals the team's owned PL club (i.e. owned-club players score ×1.5); synergy can be fractional (e.g. raw 13 → +6.5).
If a team owns no PL club, synergyBonus and clubResultBonus are both 0 for that team.
Club-result bonus per fixture is tier-based: top8 = +2 win / +1 draw / 0 loss; mid = +3 / +1 / 0; promoted = +4 / +2 / 0. Bonuses sum across double-GW fixtures.
A blank GW (owned club has no PL fixture) yields clubResultBonus = 0 with summary 'Blank GW — no fixture, no bonus'.
If the FPL fixtures fetch fails when computing club-result bonus, the scorer defaults clubResultBonus to 0 and persists a 'result unavailable' summary; scoring still proceeds.

Synergy decision on reprocess uses the preserved historical plTeamId snapshot from the prior playerBreakdown JSON, not the live FPL bootstrap — mid-season PL transfers do NOT retroactively re-route synergy on already-scored GWs.
If a player has left the PL entirely (missing from the current FPL bootstrap) but a synergy snapshot exists, the last-known synergyBonus is preserved instead of falling to 0.

GW rank is assigned by sorting teams by GW totalPoints DESC, with tie-breakers in order: squadValue ASC (lower wins) → purse DESC (higher wins). SquadValue uses raw points only (synergy never compounds into FMV).
Players counted in a team's squad for GW scoring are auctionOwnership rows with `acquiredGw < gw` AND (releasedGw IS NULL OR releasedGw >= gw).

When forceReprocess=false and an auctionScores row already exists for (leagueId, gameweekId), processing is a no-op that returns the existing persisted scores; checked both outside and inside the transaction to close the race window.
On forceReprocess, existing auctionScores rows for the GW are deleted inside the transaction before new rows are inserted.

After a GW is processed, each scored team's `teams.purse` is incremented by the payout and `teams.totalIncome` is incremented by the same amount; both inside the same transaction as the auctionScores insert.

When `gameweekNumber % 10 === 0` (cycle boundaries GW10/20/30), all `auctionOwnership.status='pending_release'` rows are flipped to 'released' with `releasedGw = gameweekNumber` and the 50% refund is added to the team's purse and totalRefunds in the same transaction.
`finalizePendingReleasesNow(leagueId, gw)` runs the same pending-release finalization outside the GW boundary — invoked when a mini-auction session starts so pending players free up before bidding.

Post-commit notification fan-out: each scored team gets a 'gw_processed' notification ('Ranked #N · X pts · Payout £Y.YYM'); each team with refunds gets a 'release_refund' notification. Notification failures are logged but never bubble up to fail scoring.
GET /api/auction/economy requires a valid session cookie (401 otherwise) and a teamId query param (400 otherwise); also 404 if team not found and 400 if the team's league.format != 'auction'.

GET /api/auction/economy enforces an authorization gate after the team/league lookup: a team-type session is allowed only when `session.id === teamId` (self-only); an admin-type session is allowed only when a `leagueAdmins` row exists for `(session.id, team.leagueId)` (admin must administer the team's league); a superadmin-type session bypasses the check; any other session.type returns 403. On success the route returns initialBudget, currentPurse (= teams.purse), computedPurse (from `calculatePurse(...)`), totalSpent, totalIncome, totalRefunds, and a GW-by-GW incomeHistory sorted ascending by GW number.

GET /api/auction/finance requires either a session cookie or superadmin (401 otherwise). With `allTeams=true`, requires superadmin and a `leagueId` param (403/400 otherwise) and returns all teams' summaries.
GET /api/auction/finance?teamId=X for a team-type session is allowed only when the session's team is in the same league as the requested teamId; otherwise 403.

Team ledger is built from: initial budget (single entry at league.createdAt with gw=0), club purchase (if owned, gw=0), per-ownership purchase (− purchasePrice), per release_refund (+refund) or pending_release (informational, amount=0, isPending=true), per scored GW payout (+payout, only if payout > 0), completed trades (trade_swap informational + trade_cash_in/out + 5% transfer_fee for receiver), penalty slot redemptions (− redemptionPrice), and slot unlocks (− cost).

Trade receiver's transfer fee = `Math.round(grossAmount × 0.05)` (5%); net cash amount credited = grossAmount − feeAmount and the fee is emitted as a separate `transfer_fee` ledger entry with negative amount.
Pending-release ledger entries have amount=0 and isPending=true and do NOT affect runningBalance; only non-pending entries contribute to the running balance.
Ledger entries are first sorted ascending by date to compute running balance, then reversed for display so newest transactions appear first.

Single-team ledger totals are derived from the ledger itself (single source of truth): totalIncome = sum of all positive non-refund non-initial-budget entries; totalRefunds = sum of release_refund entries; totalSpent = sum of |amount| for all negative entries; totalForfeited = sum of `metadata.forfeitAmount` on release_refund entries; netPnL = totalIncome + totalRefunds − totalSpent (excludes initialBudget).
currentPurse returned by the team ledger equals the runningBalance of the most recent non-pending entry (NOT `teams.purse`) — guarantees ledger and displayed purse agree by construction.

Both ledger and economy responses rename `teamName` to the owned PL club name (full name, normalised via `getPlTeamFullName`) when the team owns a PL club; `ownedClub` is included for tier-chip rendering.
GET /api/auction/gw-summary requires `leagueSlug` (400 otherwise), 404 if league not found, and 400 if league.format != 'auction'. No auth required — same visibility as Standings.

GW summary selectable GWs = processed GWs (have any auctionScores row) ∪ {liveGameweek if present}; the picker defaults to the highest selectable GW when no `gw` param is supplied or the supplied GW isn't selectable.

In live mode (selectedGw === liveGameweek), each team's GW score is computed on the fly via `calculateAuctionTeamScore` (no auctionScores row yet); payout is shown as `getPayoutForRank(gwRank)` based on the in-flight ranking.

League rank delta = previousLeagueRank − currentLeagueRank (positive = climbed); previous ranks are persisted cumulative through (selectedGw − 1), available only when at least one prior GW is processed.

Historical mode tolerates two playerBreakdown JSON shapes: post-club-auction `{elementId,name,rawPoints,synergyBonus,plTeamId}` and legacy `{elementId,name,points}`; legacy rows map `points` → `rawPoints` and default `synergyBonus=0`, `plTeamId=null`.
Legacy auctionScores rows that pre-date the persisted `clubResultSummary` column are backfilled on the fly using `backfillClubSummaries` so tooltips still display a scoreline.
GET /api/auction/scoring-status requires admin or superadmin session (403 otherwise) and a `leagueId` param (400 otherwise); 400 if league.format != 'auction'.
Scoring status per GW = `{number, gameweekId, totalManagers, scored, isPending: scored < totalManagers}`; totalManagers includes ghost teams (no `isGhost=false` filter on the count).
PATCH /api/superadmin/score-adjustments requires superadmin (403 otherwise), valid JSON body, an `id`, and a non-empty `reason` string (400 otherwise); 404 if score row not found.

PATCH /api/superadmin/score-adjustments requires at least one of `synergyBonus` or `clubResultBonus` (400 otherwise). CODE-CONFIRMED: may be a defect — values are only accepted when `Number.isInteger(...)`, but synergyBonus is a REAL column that can be fractional (e.g. 6.5 from raw 13 × 0.5); fractional overrides are silently rejected.

On a successful PATCH, totalPoints is recomputed as `rawPoints + newSynergy + newClubResult` (rawPoints is NOT editable) and an auditLogs row of type `AUCTION_SCORE_ADJUSTMENT` is written with the before→after delta and admin-supplied reason in the same transaction as the update.
GET /api/superadmin/score-adjustments without `leagueId` returns the list of auction leagues plus a map of distinct processed GW numbers per league for the dropdown bootstrap.

GET /api/superadmin/score-adjustments with `leagueId` requires a numeric `gameweek` param (400 otherwise) and 404s if no gameweeks row matches; returns scores joined with team names ordered by rank ASC.

Square value snapshot used for tie-breaking sums `calculateFMV(purchasePrice, rawPoints)` across each team's active ownership rows; uses RAW points only — synergy never compounds into FMV/squad value/trades.

`teams.purse` is incremented on payouts (process-gameweek), purchases (resolve-bid), club purchases (club-auction), refunds (process-gameweek finalization), slot unlocks (unlock-slot), penalty redemptions (redeem-slot), and trade cash; the canonical purse for display is the ledger's running balance, not `teams.purse`.

defects.title: GET /api/auction/economy returns any team's full economy/income history to any authenticated session
defects.description: The handler validates that a session cookie is present and that the requested team exists in an auction league, but never compares `session.id`/`session.type` against the requested `teamId`. Any logged-in team (or admin/superadmin) can request any other team's `initialBudget`, `currentPurse`, `totalSpent`, `totalIncome`, `totalRefunds`, and full per-GW `incomeHistory`.
defects.expectedBehaviour: Non-admin team sessions should only be able to read their own economy, OR (matching the finance route's policy) any team in the same league. Cross-league reads must be 403.
defects.actualBehaviour: Any authenticated session reads any teamId's full economy regardless of league membership or ownership.
defects.notes: Fix options: (a) Mirror the /api/auction/finance same-league check (compare requested teamId's leagueId to session team's leagueId); (b) Restrict to self-only unless caller is admin/superadmin. Option (a) is consistent with how Finance treats peer teams in the same league. [DEV] Self-verified: tsc passes (no new errors in touched file; pre-existing unrelated TVT test-spec errors remain), manual diff review clean. Awaiting QA re-run of pinningTestCases. [QA] Re-run TC-ECON-049, TC-ECON-050 against the fix. Expected behaviour now matches the original 'expectedBehaviour' field: team sessions asking for a different teamId must receive 403; admin sessions without a leagueAdmins row for the team's leagueId must receive 403; superadmin can read any team; team owners can read their own team. [BA] BR-ECON-026 and AC-ECON-034 currently document the pre-fix (defective) behaviour — please update them to describe the new authorization policy (superadmin → any team; admin → only teams in their administered leagues; team → self-only; otherwise 403). [QA-VERIFIED]: 2026-05-25 — TC-ECON-049 + TC-ECON-050 inverted; access control confirmed. [BA-UPDATED]: 2026-05-25 — BR-ECON-026 + AC-ECON-034 updated to reflect fixed behaviour.
defects.resolution: Added an authorization gate after the team/league lookup in src/app/api/auction/economy/route.ts (lines 36-58). Policy by session.type: 'team' must match teamId (self-only); 'admin' must have a leagueAdmins row for the requested team's leagueId; 'superadmin' bypasses the check; any other session.type returns 403. Imported `leagueAdmins` from `@/lib/db` to support the admin scope check. Chose the stricter self-only policy for team sessions (rather than same-league as Finance) because the economy response includes private spend/income/refund totals that should not be visible to league peers.

defects.title: Superadmin score adjustments silently reject fractional synergyBonus values even though the column is REAL
defects.description: PATCH /api/superadmin/score-adjustments only accepts `synergyBonus` and `clubResultBonus` when `Number.isInteger(...)` is true. However, `auctionScores.synergyBonus` is a REAL column and is naturally fractional (0.5 × raw — e.g. raw 13 → 6.5). Passing `synergyBonus: 6.5` is treated as 'not provided' and, if no other valid field is sent, returns 400 'Provide at least one of synergyBonus or clubResultBonus'.
defects.expectedBehaviour: synergyBonus should accept any finite number (the schema's REAL column supports fractions). clubResultBonus should remain integer-only since the schema column is INTEGER.
defects.actualBehaviour: Any fractional synergy override (e.g. 6.5, 4.5) is silently treated as missing and may cause the PATCH to 400.
defects.notes: Fix: replace `Number.isInteger(body.synergyBonus)` with `Number.isFinite(body.synergyBonus)` for the synergyBonus branch only; keep `Number.isInteger` on clubResultBonus. Low risk — purely a validation widening.
